draft.emotion: restless and unamused, dragging feet with nothing to do
notes: Do not confuse with 지루하다 (boring/tedious). 심심하다 describes a person feeling bored from having nothing to do, while 지루하다 describes something (like a movie or class) that is dull and tiresome.
When describing food, it is similar to 싱겁다 (not salty enough, bland).
